glossEn: the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained
note: the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed。线索：on the basis of / a sound basis。搭配上几乎只用 on the basis of。

glossEn: the most important or necessary part of something
note: the most important or necessary part of something。线索：the basis of the argument / water is the basis of life。与 s1 的判别句：We act on the basis of evidence.（前提）/ The basis of the problem is poverty.（成因部分）
